entries.scope: Controlled handling of the unrepresentable signed Int32 division at the shared VM boundary
entries.rationale: The observable arithmetic-fault contract gains diagnostic 212 and security documentation must describe the closed exception boundary, preserved stack state, and unchanged legitimate division semantics.
readerPaths: VM instruction set to diagnostic contract and hosting guidance
Threat model to security scenario, checklist, and executable regression evidence
NuGet package README to structured arithmetic-fault handling
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation node; existing VM, hosting, package, architecture, and security reader paths are updated in place.
entries.languageStrategy: User-facing guidance remains German first and English second at CEFR B2; stable code and resource identifiers remain language-neutral.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The shared .NET VM kernel is exercised through direct instructions, mnemonic and numeric P-Code, batch and step execution, German and English resources, missing-resource fallbacks, and valid signed-division controls.
entries.risk: Low after focused and full regression gates; future arithmetic operators, numeric widths, VM decoders, resource keys, or public diagnostic contracts require re-evaluation.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A change to OPR arithmetic, integer representation, VM execution boundaries, diagnostics, localization, CLI/IDE presentation, or package behavior.
